answer.reason: The frozen depth failure is unreachable. Parsing routes every object and array through guards using the same nesting limit as printing. The harness prints only a successfully parsed tree, and it has no assertion that printing returns a non-NULL value.

scope_contract.reason: Printing parser-produced objects is part of this entry’s operation and state.

feasible_trigger.reason: A parser-produced object cannot reach the printer at the rejection depth: parse_value dispatches objects and arrays to parsers that reject a container when depth reaches CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT. The printer applies that same check before incrementing depth.

observable_consequence.reason: The new depth rejection cannot occur for an object accepted by this parse call. The complete harness also contains no check that printed_json is non-NULL.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The harness’s ordinary route already prints every parser-accepted object depth. Buffered, formatted and unformatted choices all dispatch object values to print_object; none is blocked at an accepted depth.

identity_preserved.reason: The same parser-produced object and accepted-depth condition are assessed on both sides. The old printer has no depth check; the added after-side check matches the parser’s limit.
